# de Zélicourt et al. 2018, Fig 1

`fig1.png` is Figure 1 of de Zélicourt A, Synek L, Saad MM, … Hirt H (2018) *Ethylene induced plant stress
tolerance by Enterobacter sp. SA187 is mediated by 2-keto-4-methylthiobutyric acid production.*
PLoS Genet 14(3): e1007273, doi:10.1371/journal.pgen.1007273, published under CC BY 4.0. It shows alfalfa
fresh and dry biomass (t/ha) for mock vs SA187-coated seed, under irrigation at EC 3.12 and 7.81 dS/m,
two seasons, field station Hada Al-Sham (KSA).

`fig1_digitised.json` is produced by `reproducibility/v07/digitise_fig1.py`: bar heights read from the
pixels, calibrated on the y-axis ticks; the script refuses to run if the image hash changes and fails if
the digitised SA187 effects differ from the percentages printed on the figure by more than 1.5 points.
Per-plot data are not published.
